sentences.text:
---- 
CORAM: HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE SANJAY KUMAR DWIVEDI ---

For the Petitioners :- Mr. Ajit Kumar, Advocate For the State :- Mr. Deepankar Roy, Advocate ----
04/07.12.2024

Learned counsel appearing for the petitioner submits that the petitioners are the father-in-law, mother-in-law, sister-in-law and brother-in-law respectively and the husband is not the petitioner in the present writ petition.
He submits that the case has been registered under Section 498A and other Sections of the IPC as well as Sections 3 and 4 of the Dowry Prohibition Act.

He submits that so far these petitioners are concerned there are general and omnibus allegation.
2. Issue notice upon the respondent No.2 under registered cover with A/D as well as by ordinary process for which requisites must be filed within a week.
3. Let this matter appear on 18th February, 2025.
4. Till the next date, no coercive steps shall be taken against the petitioners in connection with Latehar Mahila P.S. Case No.12 of 2022 G.R. No.306 of 2024, pending in the Court of learned Chief Judicial Magistrate, Latehar.
(Sanjay Kumar Dwivedi, J.) Sangam/
